exposure: Women with ICP who did not receive UDCA
Women with ICP who received UDCA
cohort: 114 women with ICP and 3725 women without ICP who delivered at a hospital between September 2017 and August 2019
finding: ICP increased the risk of preeclampsia, cesarean section, and preterm birth, but UDCA treatment could reduce the rate of preterm birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more likely in women with ICP compared to controls.
